## Overview
### Introduction to xAI: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent
The xAI: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent model, released by X-ai on 2024-01-01, is a standard, non-open-source AI solution. This model is part of the x-ai/grok-4.20-multi-agent family and is designed to handle a variety of tasks, including text generation, coding, analysis, and summarization. With its multi-agent architecture, Grok 4.20 is capable of processing complex inputs and producing structured outputs, making it a versatile tool for developers.

### Architecture and Capabilities
The xAI: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent model boasts a context window of 2,000,000 tokens and can produce outputs of up to 4,096 tokens. Its capabilities include text processing, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs. These features make it an ideal choice for applications such as chat, text generation, coding, analysis, and summarization. The model's strengths are further highlighted by its benchmark scores, including an MMLU score of 80.0 and an LMSYS Arena ELO score of 1200. With a knowledge cutoff of 2023-12, developers can rely on Grok 4.20 to provide accurate and up-to-date information.

### Pricing and Use Cases
The pricing for xAI: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent is as follows: $2.0 per 1M tokens for input, $6.0 per 1M tokens for output, and no charges for cached input or batch input. Based on these rates, the cost for 1,000 calls (avg 500 tokens) would be $4.0, while 10,000 calls would cost $40.0, and 100,000 calls would cost $400.0.
